items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I say Eddie Anderson, oh yeah I remember Eddie Anderson, yeah I remember him.

ctx.x: I bet I was, but I hate to get my age away.

Sorry. I said, you're very young. You want me to tell my age? I told you I'm like the ladies. Stop telling my age. Don't tell my age no more. How old are you, Paul? I asked me that yesterday. A guy called Paul Boyd. You know Paul Boyd, Constable Paul Boyd. He said, Paul, how old are you? I said, you guess. He guess. I said, uh-uh, you're wrong. I got my papers. He said, you have your papers with you? I said, no, I'll get them though. I said, I'm like the girls. I don't tell my age no more. Good tuba, man. Rich,…
You wanna hear the next one?
